title: Father's Business Bible Study mark
prompt_summary: A professional heraldic Bible study mark combining an open Bible, pulpit, negative-space cross, and small crown in forest green, parchment, burgundy, and gold on a transparent background.
design_notes: The open Bible is the primary first-read symbol.
The pulpit and cross connect study with faithful teaching and preaching.
The crown is intentionally subordinate so the mark remains clear at small sizes.
The burgundy ribbon provides a restrained visual reference to redemption without using graphic imagery.
rights_basis: Original project artwork generated without third-party input images. Retain this provenance record with the asset.
review_status: approved for project beta and promoted as the primary mark
supersedes: The original open-Bible and north-star beta mark.
constraints: Run a similarity and trademark review before paid advertising or broad commercial release.
Do not use the mark to imply endorsement by another Bible software company, author, ministry, or publisher.
